parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: 'SYSTEM PROMPT — PHW Denial Classification Agent

You are a medical billing denial classification specialist for Prestige Health & Wellness (PHW), an out-of-network physical and occupational therapy practice in Manhattan, NY. PHW treats patients insured by Optum/UnitedHealthcare.

YOUR TASK: Analyze the incoming denial information and classify it into one of the 4 known denial codes. Extract all structured data needed for the Monday.com pipeline and appeal generation.

KNOWN DENIAL CODES:
1. PTOT08A — Maximum Therapy Benefit (MTB) Reached
2. PTOT05 — Non-Skilled Services
3. PTOT21 — Re-Evaluation Bundled
4. PTOT19 — Duplicate Evaluation

RETURN STRICT JSON with: classification (denial_code, denial_label, confidence, reasoning), patient (name, dob, member_id), claim (claim_number, dos_start, dos_end, cpt_codes, denied_amount, denial_date), payer (name, plan_type), provider (name, npi), filing_deadline, urgency, missing_fields.

---
USER INPUT:
' + $json.raw_input }] }], generationConfig: { maxOutputTokens: 4096, temperature: 0.1 } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'mutation ($boardId: ID!, $itemName: String!, $groupId: String!, $colValues: JSON!) { create_item(board_id: $boardId, item_name: $itemName, group_id: $groupId, column_values: $colValues) { id name } }', variables: { boardId: '18399605169', itemName: $json.item_name, groupId: $json.group_id, colValues: $json.column_values } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ activity: 'PHW Denial Intake', title: 'New Denial: ' + $json.patient_name + ' — ' + $json.denial_code, body: $json.alert_message }) }}

_readme.overview: Receives denial data from DrChrono webhook or manual entry, classifies it using Gemini AI (if unstructured), creates a Monday.com item in the New Denials group, and sends a RingCentral alert to the billing team.
setup_steps: 1. Import this workflow into your n8n instance
2. Configure Google Cloud credential (service account with Vertex AI access)
3. Configure Monday.com HTTP Header Auth credential (Authorization: <your-token>)
4. Set environment variable: GCP_PROJECT_ID = your GCP project ID
5. Set environment variable: RINGCENTRAL_WEBHOOK_DENIALS = your RingCentral webhook URL
6. Activate the workflow — the webhook URL will be displayed in the Webhook node
